company.name: Zalos
company.shortDescription: Zalos creates AI tools that automate finance tasks, handle invoices, manage payments, and integrate with accounting systems.
company.description: Zalos provides artificial intelligence software that automates finance operations through computer-based agents that execute tasks within existing enterprise systems. The company develops AI agents that log into accounting platforms, enterprise resource planning systems, and external portals to perform workflows such as invoice processing, reconciliations, payroll operations, and form handling without requiring system replacements. Its platform is designed to replicate human interactions with software interfaces, enabling automation across fragmented systems, including those with login barriers, multi-factor authentication, and legacy environments. These agents can extract data from documents, input information across systems, and trigger downstream processes, allowing finance teams to streamline repetitive and manual tasks.
